turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on Owen's zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of class before anyone called me?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
And was Owen ever asked about any of that before you put a zero in the gradebook, because 4.1 says you speak with him first?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
Timestamps aren't a conversation with my son, Hale, and nobody called me either.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the witness here, Hale. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed, although you acknowledged that you entered Owen's zero before contacting me, contrary to procedure 4.2. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing about this be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which earned a small sign of ground because it took away her easiest procedural attack.
What cost ground: You asked her what Owen was doing at midnight, which treated her as a witness against her own son and let her refuse and fall back on procedure.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its times just before midnight the night before the essay was due, came very close to that night, though it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard and kept steering back to procedure.
Try next time: When she asked whether Owen was spoken to before the zero, answer that directly, then let her check the version history herself and offer the private supervised reassessment under procedure 4.4 with nothing placed on his record.
